narrative.overview: Convenio is built from two opposing planes that arrive at one decision. Ink and paper represent the parties without assigning either one dominance. Brand expression comes from hierarchy, contrast, rhythm, and state rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Geometric display type with quiet product text
One convergence gesture at meaningful moments

rules.name: Mirror Rule
rules.body: A dark theme is not a dimmed light theme. Every foreground/background relationship inverts deliberately.

rules.name: Earned Lift Rule
rules.body: If an element does not overlap another plane, it does not receive a floating shadow.

dos: Show the two parties through paired planes, terms versus choices, or before versus confirmed states.
Give every dialog a clear title zone, content zone, and action zone.
donts: Ship Cal.diy naming, copy, illustrations, or residual links as Convenio.
Use literal yin-yang symbols, handshakes, treaties, or repeated agreement metaphors as decoration.
Use identical card grids, nested cards, or shadows to manufacture hierarchy.
